notes.title: Zoom + fixes! 1.10 Just Released
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Thank you for your support and feedback.

In today's update we've added the ability to auto-zoom on the selected tile:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AgYWZzb.gif[/img]

Or if you switch of auto-zoom you can freely zoom with your mouse wheel, and pan by dragging the board:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3M4o3fG.gif[/img]

Additionally, you can also de-activate in the options the top floor glow/shake animation, which was unpleasant for some of you!

Other fixes:

FIXED Spirit of Strength 
FIXED Achievements  Dragon Tamer" and "Spiritual Bond"
FIXED missing localization screens, including login / signup 
FIXED Tutorial bug where players got occasionally stuck

Thank you for your continued support! And [b]if you haven't yet please leave us a review on steam! It makes a world of difference and the more exposure we can get for the game on steam the longer we'll be able to support it![/b]

Pietro and the team at HG

notes.title: Dragon Castle 1.04!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your patience, we've moved the development of the game in-house and it took us a few week to catch up with everything (if you do not know Dragon Castle: the Board Game is completely cross-platform!). Here is a list of changes:

NEW FEATURES
[list]
[*] You can now see remaining Dragon tokens also when it’s not your turn.
[*] Added a button to randomize the match settings (dragon, spirit and castle layout) when creating a new game.
[*] Added a button to reset the match settings (dragon, spirit and castle layout) when creating a new game.
[/list]

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Achievement “Spiritual Bond” fixed and now obtainable
[*] Fixed various occasion where Spirit of Strength could get stuck
[*] Fixed Dragon of Bravery score calculation
[*] Fixed Dragon of Tranquillity score calculation
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the use of Spirit of Beauty, Spirit of Strength, Spirit of Wind and Spirit of Cunning in online games
[*] Fixed various minors bugs
[*] Improved stability and optimization
[*] Resolution dropdown fixed
[*] Achievements’ progress now works properly on steam client
[*] Fixed the descriptions of spirit related achievements
[/list]

Let us know what you think in the comments and thank you for your support!

Cheers,

The team at HG <3
